title: West Nashville Studio near Belle Meade Plantation
description:
Step into calm. This light-filled, thoughtfully designed micro-apartment is your modern, peaceful retreat in Nashville. Ideal for the solo traveler or a couple's getaway. Simple, stylish, and supremely comfortable.

The space
✨ Your Nashville Home Base: Comfort & Convenience
Step into a space designed for relaxation and ease. We’ve equipped your apartment with everything you need to feel instantly at home and connected.

Inside Your Cozy Retreat:
Relaxation: Sink into the comfortable sofa for a movie night on the Smart TV.

Speed: Stay connected with lightning-fast fiber internet.

Essentials: Thoughtful amenities stocked for your comfort and convenience.

Convenience & Privacy:
Dedicated Parking: Enjoy the ease of your own private parking space.

Independence: Access your unit with a private, separate entrance.

Accessibility: Easily explore Nashville—whether you drive, use ride-shares, or walk!

Insider Experience:
Skip the tourist traps! We provide local insights, tips, and hidden gems to guide you to the best attractions and restaurants, helping you experience Nashville like a true local.

Guest access
You will have one private parking spot and private entry into the space. A second car can be accommodated upon request.

Other things to note
We’ve provided a few kitchen basics to make your stay more comfortable: Keurig coffee pods, half-and-half, tea bags, sugar, salt, pepper, a filtered water pitcher, ice trays, and more. We’ve also included toiletry items like shampoo, conditioner and body wash.

Please let us know if you have any special requests. We’ll do our best to accommodate them.
